lead: For a first jet ski ride past the Burj Al Arab, book the Yoush Water Sports 30-minute tour: €33 per jet ski, two riders can share it, and photos, videos and an ice cream are included. That works out at about €1.11 per minute, or roughly €17 each for a couple.

The catch most people miss: nearly every tour has "Burj Al Arab & Atlantis" in its title, but the cheapest 30-minute rides from Umm Suqeim (Yoush, Nemo, Sun and Fun) list only the Burj Al Arab stretch. If Atlantis and the Palm matter, book a longer option that actually routes past them, or start from Dubai Marina.

Below, 7 different tours are compared on what actually changes the booking: minutes on the water, route, price per jet ski vs per person, riders per ski, photo and video, departure marina and age limits. Filter by budget, longer rides or the Palm route, then check the side-by-side table under the cards.

review: This is the default booking for a Burj Al Arab jet ski ride. For €33.24 you get one jet ski for 30 minutes, and that price covers one or two riders. Split between two people it comes to about €16.60 each, which nobody else on this page beats once you account for the time on the water.

The route is the short, photogenic one: a safety briefing at the P&O Marina Port fishing harbour in Umm Suqeim 2, then out to the Burj Al Arab, past Jumeirah Beach Hotel and back with the Burj Khalifa skyline in view. The instructor takes the photos and videos for free, and you also get ice cream, water and access to lockers, a changing room and an open shower.

Compared with Nemo (#2), the two are almost the same product from the same harbour at the same price. Yoush edges it on rating and per-minute cost, and it lets you swap drivers mid-ride. Nemo's extra is a café stop with ice cream or pizza. If you want Atlantis or the Palm, look at the coastline tour (#3), Shark from Dubai Marina (#4) or Sun and Fun's 60-minute option (#7), whose routes include them.

guide.h2: Dubai Jet Ski Tours Side by Side: Minutes, Route and € per Minute
guide.html:
The price on the card is not the price of the ride. What you really pay depends on how many minutes you get, whether the price is per jet ski or per person, and how far the route goes. Here are the 7 tours on the same axes, using the from-price of the shortest option.

What the table shows: six of the seven tours start next to the Burj Al Arab, five of them from the fishing harbours in Umm Suqeim 2. On the 30-minute rides, Yoush and Nemo list only the Burj Al Arab and Jumeirah Beach Hotel stretch even though Atlantis is in their names, and Sun and Fun keeps the Royal Atlantis for its 60-minute option. Atlantis is spelled out on Sun and Fun's 60 minutes, Shark's Marina route and the coastline tour; A One's 45-minute ride names it and offers an optional Ain Dubai stop beyond the Palm. The fastest way to reach Ain Dubai is to start from Dubai Marina with Shark.

Per ski vs per person matters most for couples. Yoush, Nemo, A One and the coastline tour charge per jet ski for one or two riders, so two people sharing a ski pay half. Friends Aqua charges per person, so on a short ride it only makes sense for solo riders or groups who each want their own ski.

guide.h2: Which Jet Ski Tour Should You Book?
guide.html:
• First ride, best value: Yoush 30 minutes at €33.24 per ski. Photos, video and ice cream included, and the best rating on the page.
  • You want a snack and a sit-down after: Nemo. One ice cream or pizza per ski at the café 50 steps away, and two car parks on site.
  • You want Atlantis without a 2-hour commitment: Sun and Fun's 60-minute option, which spells out the Royal Atlantis. For a 45-minute middle ground, A One is €69.14 per ski for one or two riders, with an optional Ain Dubai stop.
  • You are staying in Dubai Marina, JBR or on the Palm: Shark leaves from Dubai Marina and goes straight to Ain Dubai and Atlantis. Drivers must be 18+.
  • You want the whole coastline and swim stops: the 1.5–2 hour coastline tour, the only route covering Burj Al Arab, Palm, Ain Dubai and The World.
  • Group with mixed lengths or arriving by car: Friends Aqua with parking, beach access and 30, 60 or 90 minutes.
  • Your group prefers a briefing in German, Russian, Italian or Spanish: Sun and Fun, with instructors in 9 languages.

Want more speed after the jet ski? Our adrenaline experiences in Dubai compares the bigger thrills, and if you would rather see the same coastline from above, the Dubai helicopter tours comparison covers the Palm and Burj Al Arab routes by air.

guide.h2: Practical Tips: Licence, Age, What to Bring and Getting There
guide.html:
Do you need a licence?

None of these 7 tours asks for a boat or jet ski licence. You get a safety briefing, then follow a guide on your own jet ski. What you do need is ID: every listing asks for a passport or ID card, and Sun and Fun wants an original passport or Emirates ID at registration.

Age limits

Most operators let you drive from 16 (Yoush, A One, Sun and Fun, the coastline tour). Shark in Dubai Marina requires drivers to be 18, with under-18s riding as passengers next to an adult. Passengers can be as young as 4 or 5 depending on the operator. The coastline tour has a 136 kg (300 lbs) limit, and A One is not suitable for people with back problems.

Getting there

Six of the seven start next to the Burj Al Arab, five of them from the fishing harbours of Umm Suqeim 2 on Jumeirah Street. Nemo has two public car parks on site and Friends Aqua includes parking. Shark is the exception, inside Dubai Marina. Plan your own transport: hotel pickup is not included on Nemo, A One, Sun and Fun or Friends Aqua.

What to bring and what costs extra

  • Swimwear and a towel (Sun and Fun and Friends Aqua do not provide towels).
  • Passport or Emirates ID.
  • Arrive 15–20 minutes early for registration and the briefing.
  • Photos and videos are free on most tours, but Nemo asks you to collect them before you leave the base.
  • Tips are optional and not included at Shark and Sun and Fun.

Building a full Dubai day around it? Pair a morning ride with an afternoon at one of the best water parks in Dubai, or head inland for sunset with one of the 10 desert safaris compared.

faqs.q: How much does a jet ski tour in Dubai cost?
faqs.a: A guided 30-minute jet ski ride past the Burj Al Arab starts at about €33–36 per jet ski, which covers one or two riders on most tours. A 45-minute ride costs about €69 per ski, and a 1.5–2 hour coastline tour about €131 per ski. Friends Aqua charges per person, from €39.49.

faqs.q: Can you see Atlantis on a 30-minute jet ski tour?
faqs.a: Not on the 30-minute rides compared here. Yoush and Nemo list only the Burj Al Arab and Jumeirah Beach Hotel stretch, and Sun and Fun keeps the Royal Atlantis for its 60-minute option. The A One 45-minute ride names Atlantis and offers an optional Ain Dubai stop beyond the Palm, so confirm its route at check-in. Starting from Dubai Marina with Shark gets you to the Palm and Atlantis fastest.

faqs.q: Can two people share one jet ski?
faqs.a: Yes. Every tour here uses two-seat jet skis. Yoush, Nemo, A One and the coastline tour charge per jet ski, so two people pay one price. On Yoush you can also swap drivers during the ride. Friends Aqua charges per person instead.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to ride a jet ski in Dubai?
faqs.a: Not on these guided tours. You get a safety briefing and follow your guide. Bring a passport or Emirates ID, and check the driver age: 16+ on most tours, 18+ at Shark in Dubai Marina.

On most of them, yes. Yoush, Nemo, A One, Friends Aqua and Sun and Fun include photos and videos taken by the guide. The coastline tour includes photos, and Shark offers free photos on a mobile phone.

faqs.q: Where do Dubai jet ski tours start?
faqs.a: Six of the seven start next to the Burj Al Arab, five of them from the fishing harbours in Umm Suqeim 2. Shark starts in Dubai Marina, which is closer to Ain Dubai, JBR and the Palm. If you are staying on the Palm, see our Palm Jumeirah hotels guide.

faqs.q: What is the minimum age for a jet ski tour in Dubai?
faqs.a: Drivers must be 16 on most tours and 18 at Shark. Passengers can join from 4 or 5 years old depending on the operator; Friends Aqua and Yoush do not take children under 5.

methodology: We compared 7 different guided jet ski tours in Dubai, chosen from the city's most popular and best-rated options, on the details that decide the booking: minutes on the water, route and landmarks, price per jet ski versus per person, riders per ski, cost per minute, photo and video, departure marina, driver and passenger age limits, and facilities. Prices are the live from-prices for a normal date. Where one operator sold the same route twice, we kept the version that adds something different.
